backup_target: At least three verified copies across separate locations, including an offline copy; a target plan, not a claim that these copies exist.
verification: Actual restore test before declaring a backup usable
Maintain media separately from AI summaries
inactive_policy: No automatic inference of death or authorization from silence.
memorial_mode: Only after an explicit authorized change: freeze biography, mark historical responses, disable autonomous outward actions.
migration: Rebuild search and swap model adapter without rewriting the underlying identity or source archive.
